title: hearty dense flaked tunisian chicken tagine
description: tangy, dense, meal-prep tunisian dish featuring flaked almonds, miso-marinate, anti-inflammatory-friendly, vessel=earthenware-bowl
instructions: in a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
add the chicken to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
in a large earthenware bowl, heat a tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
add the marinated chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
add the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and flaked almonds to the bowl.
cover the bowl with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
serve hot over couscous or rice.
